Firebase JavaScript SDK 12.4.0, compat bundles (Apache-2.0).
Source: https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.4.0/firebase-{app,auth,firestore}-compat.js
Repository: https://github.com/firebase/firebase-js-sdk
Bundled locally so loading application scripts does not require a CDN connection.
Third-party bundles retain original syntax; ES5 rules apply to our application files.
